intent.raw: how can we make this cohesive modular system now
intent.objective: Refine the approved Arcanum building-system research into an owner-preserving modular architecture and a non-executed migration plan with typed transitions, explicit gates, compatibility obligations, and falsifiable evidence requirements.
intent.operator_sentence: how can we make this cohesive modular system now

route_menu.context_hint: The route selects an architecture hypothesis to test, not a final owner or implementation decision.

items.label: Owner-preserving kernel
items.description: Share record shapes and transition validation while each capability retains its semantic and effect authority.

items.label: Hierarchical coordinator
items.description: Give one top-level coordinator the build state machine and delegate bounded capability operations.

items.label: Event-ledger composition
items.description: Compose owner receipts through a durable work graph while keeping effect authority with each producer.

items.label: Kernel plus causal journal
items.description: Use structurally validated owner envelopes with a non-authoritative append-only causal journal for crash, join, and replay diagnostics.

items.label: Bilateral adapter first
items.description: Prove one real owner boundary with versioned adapters and witnesses before extracting any universal envelope.

technique_overlays.trigger: The requested architecture must be derived in the canonical ten-stage order from an approved evidence package.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-first stage consumes a named prior artifact, frame, decision, ledger, or receipt, and every stage is grouped under the dispatch id.

technique_overlays.trigger: Three plausible system shapes exist and the series-owner, producer-owner, and registry-owner questions remain unresolved.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route records the tested hypothesis, preserves viable alternatives, and blocks implementation claims when a consequential owner is unresolved.

technique_overlays.trigger: Cohesion pressures conflict with owner sovereignty, and two existing capabilities claim overlapping multi-unit coordination.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Generation and critique alternate, convergence criteria are explicit, and stable disagreement remains named residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: Owner-preserving kernel, hierarchical coordinator, and event-ledger composition are materially different architectures.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Alternatives are compared on authority safety, cohesion, migration, compatibility, replay safety, diagnostics, and proofability; rejection reasons and recomposition are recorded.

technique_overlays.trigger: The current building system is distributed across authoring, readiness, execution, closeout, recursive state, runtime, lifecycle, and projection owners.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The run emits a module and transition artifact whose components preserve one meaning across every owner boundary.

technique_overlays.trigger: The selected architecture needs a controlled protocol trace before implementation planning and before the real owner-chain witness.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: A synthetic positive trace and finite one-fault traces name expected evidence, first stop, forbidden effects, and repair routing.

technique_overlays.trigger: Fresh audited research, older Invoke/Craft decisions, rejected claims, and open residue are material to the architecture.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Prior evidence is cited by stable path, duplicate claims are not recopied as new proof, and each unresolved item keeps an owner or next route.

technique_overlays.trigger: The refinement package is private-parent evidence while the eventual Arcanum capability surface is public.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Private evidence stays in the parent run; any public candidate is rewritten from public sources and scanned before a later authorized publication route.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The preferred shared-kernel hypothesis could accidentally centralize authority while appearing modular.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One read-only system-boundary critic should independently try to falsify the module boundaries, transition ownership, and compatibility plan while the parent owns the ten Refine stages and final synthesis.
context: The approved report found a duplicate series reducer and three unbound owners.
The positive owner-chain witness remains unverified.
Two Orchestrate defects were reproduced but not canonically repaired.
Public Arcanum and private parent evidence must remain separated.

roles.purpose: Attack the candidate architecture for authority collapse, duplicate gates, missing producers or consumers, circular owner dependencies, false fixture-to-product inference, migration dead ends, and public/private leakage.
roles.owns: read-only counterexample analysis and a bounded critic receipt; no source, plan, ledger, registry, or runtime mutation

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approved by the operator on 2026-08-05: run the deep ten-stage Refine route and one read-only system-boundary critic.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: block if the approved findings, evidence closure, or public-private source classification cannot be bound

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: block if cohesion, modularity, owner, gate, receipt, or proof ceiling remains equivocal

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: shared terms do not absorb owner authority
duplicate or missing transitions are named
unresolved disagreements retain an owner or next route
stop_conditions: block if a proposed shared term collapses two authority states

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: ask before any external research or scope expansion beyond the approved local evidence

steps.name: Distill architecture tournament
stop_conditions: block if no alternative preserves both owner sovereignty and an auditable end-to-end composition

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design
stop_conditions: block if any transition has zero or multiple effect owners or if the shared kernel performs owner work

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: all owner crossings have typed inputs and receipts
series ownership is decided or routed to Decision Gate
compatibility does not require a flag day
stop_conditions: block if the design hides an unresolved authority decision behind routing or ledger state

steps.name: Distill Repair and protocol toy game
stop_conditions: block planning if the synthetic positive trace skips an owner receipt or any one-fault trace permits a forbidden downstream effect

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: block if a work unit mutates public Arcanum before its private design, owner decision, validation, or parity prerequisite is explicit

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
convergence_criteria: critic counterexamples are repaired or preserved as residue
plan claims do not exceed evidence
stop_conditions: block final pass if any stage lacks an artifact or exact blocked reason, or if the result implies implementation or promotion

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json passes the canonical schema and semantic validator, and every cited technique changes a step, gate, evidence expectation, or route decision.
The operator explicitly approves the deep ten-stage run and the one read-only system-boundary critic before native stages or delegation.
Each stage records a native stage receipt, an approved subagent receipt where applicable, or an exact blocked reason before pass is claimed.
Every semantic transition names exactly one effect owner and a separate validator or consumer where applicable; unresolved owner selection is routed to Decision Gate.
Private research remains in the parent run and no public Arcanum candidate copies private prose, paths, authority assumptions, or evidence ledgers.
Research remains local-only; any named external-context gap requires a new operator confirmation and a protected-context record.

Design, toy-game, fixture, route, and plan evidence are not described as implementation, synchronized product execution, lifecycle decision, registry release, publication, deployment, or production proof.
Every canonical stage has an artifact or exact blocked reason; the final result includes modules, transitions, alternatives, residue, migration, validation, and next owner routes.

promotion_guardrails: Refine produces private design and a non-executed plan; it does not mutate public Arcanum capability sources.
A selected architecture hypothesis is not an owner decision, lifecycle decision, registry release, or implementation result.
Craft and Inventory remain scoped state or read models and cannot become execution or promotion authority by inference.
Fixture and toy-game evidence cannot establish the real Invoke-to-Refresh synchronized product witness.
Any later public candidate must be independently rewritten from public sources and validated through its owning lifecycle.
